title: Crossing a room with mines and lasers
target: How to get through a trapped room in R.E.P.O., given that the game ships more than one kind of mine, a trap whose activation level follows how rare its valuable is, and museum lasers kept as a system of their own.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A crew that can keep clear of each other
A way back out of the room

steps.do: Find out which kind of mine you are looking at before you touch it.
steps.because: the game ships more than one kind, with a plain mine, a stun mine and a trigger of their own (MineType, ItemMine, ItemMineStun, ItemMineTrigger)

steps.do: Expect the trap near the best valuable to be the worst one.
steps.because: a trap's activation level follows how rare the valuable it guards is (TrapActivateRarityLevel)

steps.do: Set a mine off with something thrown rather than with a body.
steps.because: a mine can be set off by rigid bodies and by forces (triggeredByRigidBodies, triggeredByForces)

steps.do: Listen for the arming and disarming beeps rather than watching for a light.
steps.because: a mine names its arming, armed and disarming sounds separately (soundArmingBeep, soundArmedBeep, soundDisarmingBeep)

steps.do: Treat the museum's lasers as one system rather than as separate beams.
steps.because: the museum keeps its security lasers as a system with a state and logic of their own (MuseumLaserState, MuseumLaserLogic)

commonMistakes: Walking into a room before reading which mines are in it.
Throwing the valuable straight at the trap that guards it.
Assuming the lasers stop when a single beam is broken.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
